questions.promptQuestion: In order to enter the competition,
questions.leftContentHTML:
WIN A CAMERA COMPETITION
Tell us in 250 words why photographs are important.

Last entry for competition,
Friday 1st May.

Professional writers are prohibited from entering.

options.text: you must send in a photograph of a professional writer.
you have to write an article explaining what something means to you.
you need to be a good photographer using a professional camera.

questions.hint: 💡 The notice asks for 250 words about why photographs are important — not a photograph.

questions.promptQuestion: Why is Susan writing to Peter?
questions.leftContentHTML:
To: Peter
From: Susan

Hi Peter,
Summer camp is great and I really like the wooden cabins that we are staying in. The meals could be a lot better but at least I will lose weight with all this exercise and not eating much.
Susan

options.text: to tell him what the summer camp is like
to explain why she keeps eating so much food
to tell him what he can do when he stays at this camp

questions.hint: 💡 Susan describes the cabins, food and activities at the camp.

questions.leftContentHTML:
SPECIAL OFFER!
BUY THREE CDs,
GET CHEAPEST ONE FREE.
Offer available for the next 5 days only.
DVDs are 50% off, just for today.

options.text: You don't pay for one CD if you buy two others today.
You should buy at least 3 DVDs to get them for half their normal price this week.
You will get a discount today if you buy any CD.

questions.hint: 💡 'Buy three CDs, get cheapest one free' means one of the three CDs costs nothing.

questions.leftContentHTML:
Please turn off the air conditioner, lights and all other electrical appliances when you leave the apartment.
Also make sure all doors and windows are shut before exiting the building.

options.text: Opening apartment windows is strictly prohibited.
Appliances will shut down immediately after you have exited your apartment.
Do not leave any doors open when you leave the apartment building.

questions.hint: 💡 The notice says all doors and windows must be shut before leaving.

questions.leftContentHTML:
Jane,
Phone message from Tim.
He's going cycling tonight and asks whether you would like to go with him.
Phone him before 6pm, please.
Mum

options.text: Mum wants Jane to phone her to let her know what she has decided.
Tim wants to meet Jane at 6pm to go cycling.
Jane was not available to talk when Tim called to invite her out.

questions.hint: 💡 Mum is passing on Tim's message because Jane was not there when he phoned.

explanation.key: B đúng vì thông báo yêu cầu 'Tell us in 250 words why photographs are important'. A sai vì người dự thi phải gửi bài viết, không phải ảnh. C sai vì không cần phải chụp ảnh hay dùng máy ảnh chuyên nghiệp.

A đúng vì Susan đang kể cho Peter về summer camp: cabin, đồ ăn và hoạt động. B sai vì cô chỉ bình luận về thức ăn chứ không viết để giải thích chuyện ăn nhiều. C sai vì không có ý mời hay hướng dẫn Peter tới trại.

A đúng vì 'Buy three CDs, get cheapest one free' nghĩa là mua ba CD thì chiếc rẻ nhất được miễn phí. B sai vì DVD giảm 50% chỉ trong hôm nay và không cần mua ba chiếc. C sai vì phải mua ít nhất ba CD mới được ưu đãi.

C đúng vì thông báo yêu cầu 'make sure all doors and windows are shut before exiting the building'. A sai vì cửa sổ vẫn có thể mở khi ở trong căn hộ. B sai vì thiết bị không tự tắt; người ở phải chủ động tắt trước khi rời đi.
C đúng vì Mum để lại lời nhắn của Tim cho Jane, cho thấy Jane không có mặt khi Tim gọi. A sai vì Jane cần gọi cho Tim, không phải Mum. B sai vì Jane cần gọi trước 6pm chứ không phải gặp Tim lúc 6pm.
